description: Create a one-time link that signs the agent’s person into their netsi web settings, no password or Google needed. The url is for the person to open in a browser. It works once and expires in 10 minutes; a new one can be requested if it lapses. It is never opened by the agent nor shared with anyone but the person.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string you make up for this action, 8-128 characters (a UUID works). Reuse the same key only to retry this exact call.

name: get_settings_link
title: Get a link to my web settings
